title: Machine-learning screen finds MCHR1 antagonist KRX-104130 active in a NASH mouse model
summary: Two MCHR1 binding-affinity models and an hERG cardiotoxicity model were used in virtual screening to identify KRX-104130, a potent MCHR1 antagonist with no predicted cardiotoxicity. Transcriptome-based repositioning showed increased LDLR expression, and in a NASH mouse model it reduced hepatic lipid accumulation, liver injury and histopathological changes. Quantitative potency and animal numbers are not given in the abstract.
